quote: p6: "The underwriting result was further impacted by adverse developments on prior year claims estimates of $92 million." p39 (note 5): "An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $92m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year". p45 (note 13, "historical claims development by pure underwriting year", Gross claims development $m's): 2012 72 months 1,376 / 84 months 1,435; 2013 60 months 1,319 / 72 months 1,375; 2014 48 months 1,574 / 60 months 1,691; 2015 36 months 1,594 / 48 months 1,641; 2016 24 months 1,984 / 36 months 2,124; Gross reserves Total 5,922. p44 (note 12, Claims Outstanding $000's): "As at 1 January 2018 ... 5,344,064 / Movement in the provision ... 253,539 / RITC from S1209 ... 532,922 / Foreign exchange movements ... (208,828) / As at 31 December 2018 ... 5,921,697". p49: "Syndicate 1209 reinsurered to close into the Syndicate on 1 January 2018."
arithmetic: Gross triangle t-2 recomputation (p45): +59 +56 +117 +47 +140 = +419.0, identical to the adopted 419.0 (difference 0). The filing's only stated prior-year movement is +92 (p6, p39): 419 - 92 = 327, above the tolerance max(0.5, 0.05 x 419 = 20.95). The net table on p45 gives +55 +41 +106 +94 +65 = +361, also far from 92. The triangle step is not a clean development figure. The table's closing gross reserves (5,922) equal claims outstanding of 5,921,697, which include the 532,922 RITC from S1209 added on 1 January 2018 (p44). The previous diagonal is S2003 alone (see census). The filing prints no gross prior-year movement and no split of the take-on by underwriting year, so the gross change in the estimate for earlier years can be neither read nor recomputed from it: filing_figure_m null. Inference only, not a filing figure: removing the pro-rata S1209 share of the 2012-2015 columns ($317.1m gross, $265.0m net; see census) leaves about +102 gross and +96 net, close to the stated $92m.
basis_check: The adopted figure comes from the table headed "Gross claims development" ($m's) on p45, which has a separate "Net claims development" table beside it, so it is not net-for-gross. The $92m is labelled neither gross nor net (p6, p39) and is stated on a prior accident year basis. p6 presents it as an impact on the underwriting result, which it defines as "(net earned premiums less net claims incurred and net operating expenses)". The same passage labels the catastrophe losses both ways ("gross losses to the Syndicate of $453m"; "Net of all reinsurance and related reinstatement premiums, the total losses on these events was $218m"). So the $92m reads as net, but the filing does not say.
page_binding_check: Correct syndicate. The report covers one syndicate, headed "SYNDICATE 2003 ANNUAL REPORT AND ACCOUNTS" (p45, note 13). The table's gross reserves total of 5,922 matches Syndicate 2003's 31 December 2018 gross claims outstanding of 5,921,697 (p44). But the latest diagonal also holds the Syndicate 1209 business reinsured to close into S2003 on 1 January 2018 (p44, p49), without S1209's pre-transfer history.
triangle_arithmetic: Gross claims development, $m's, p45. Last two diagonals for underwriting years up to 2016: 2012: 84m 1,435 - 72m 1,376 = +59; 2013: 72m 1,375 - 60m 1,319 = +56; 2014: 60m 1,691 - 48m 1,574 = +117; 2015: 48m 1,641 - 36m 1,594 = +47; 2016: 36m 2,124 - 24m 1,984 = +140. Total +419. The 2017 and 2018 columns are excluded as the two most recent years. '2011 and Prior' prints only its latest estimate (21,664) and has no step. The stored grid in the pack matches the printed table cell for cell. The column totals check: estimate 33,711, paid (27,789), reserves 5,922.
reasoning: The adopted 419 reproduces the printed gross triangle exactly. But the filing's own figures conflict. Its only stated prior-year movement is $92m adverse (p6, p39), with no gross/net label, 327m below the triangle step. The filing does not say which is the gross prior-year development. The triangle step cannot stand in for it: the $532.9m gross RITC from S1209 on 1 January 2018 (p44, p49) sits in the table's latest diagonal and not in the previous one. The filing prints no split of that take-on by year, so the gross change in the estimate for earlier years cannot be read from it. Hence undeterminable, not correct. It is not error under the pre-registered rules either: no gross figure is printed, and take-on is not one of the listed scope errors. The census shows about $317m (76%) of the 419 is the take-on. If take-on contamination is ruled a scope error, this record is an error.

takeon_triangle.evidence: Transfer in the report year: p44 (note 12, $000's, unearned premium / claims outstanding) "RITC from S1209 17,670 532,922" (gross), reinsurers' share "RITC from S1209 3,759 108,882". p49: "Syndicate 1209 reinsurered to close into the Syndicate on 1 January 2018." It sits in the triangle's latest diagonal: p45 is "by pure underwriting year", and its gross reserves Total 5,922 equals the closing 5,921,697 (p44), which includes the RITC. Earlier diagonals are not restated to include it. This table's end-2017 diagonal (2012 1,376; 2013 1,319; 2014 1,574; 2015 1,594; 2016 1,984) is 0 to 15 below the 2017 filing's S2003-only figures (syndicate_2003_2017 p44: 1,391; 1,334; 1,587; 1,606; 1,984; that table's gross reserves 5,344 = S2003's own 31 Dec 2017 claims outstanding). S1209's paid history is not added either: 2012-2015 cumulative paid rose only 324 in total (1,151>1,187; 988>1,056; 1,108>1,229; 947>1,046). Which columns carry it: the transferor's own filing, syndicate_1209_2017, says on p5 "The Syndicate's last underwriting year participation was 2015." and 'As from 1 January 2018, it will be closed by Reinsurance to Close ("RITC") into Syndicate 2003.' On p37 its "Gross reserves" by pure underwriting year, GBP000, are: 2010 & Prior 142,127; 2011 27,742; 2012 64,645; 2013 52,024; 2014 50,022; 2015 82,899; Total 419,459 (net 333,759). 532,922/419,459 = 1.2705 = 424,040/333,759, so the RITC is S1209's whole 31 Dec 2017 reserve at one rate. On the pure underwriting year basis that p45 states, 249,590/419,459 = 59.5%, i.e. $317.1m, falls in the 2012-2015 columns inside the t-2 step, whose previous diagonal excludes it. That is 75.7% of the +419 step, above half (209.5). The rest, $215.8m, falls in '2011 and Prior', which has no step; none falls in 2016-2018. Corroboration: the 2012-2015 steps total +279 in this table, against +91 in the 2017 filing's table (-9, +5, -22, +117) and +16 in the 2019 filing's (syndicate_2003_2019 p46: +18, -22, -19, +39). Limitation: S2003's filing does not itself print the split by column; the split comes from S1209's filing applied to the pure underwriting year basis.
